audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: Does Malaga Event Gear use rigging or truss to mount speakers or lights overhead?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: No. Every speaker, microphone and light we deliver is floor or stand mounted on its own tripod, confirmed against our own inventory. We do not stock or install overhead rigging or truss. See What We Do Not Do: No Rigging or Overhead Truss above.

audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: Who is actually on site to handle a safety issue during my event?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: Only on the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, which include a live technician who can reposition a stand, fix a loose cable, or react to a guest bumping equipment during the event. The Eco Pack, Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack are self run after our crew installs and tests the system, so nobody is on site to react afterward. See The Real Safety Difference above.

audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: How do you keep guests safe around speaker stands and microphone stands?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: Our crew places stands on level ground, out of primary walkways, and away from doorways, so guests are not walking through or around active equipment. On packages with a technician included, that person also watches for a stand getting nudged or a guest standing too close during the event itself. See Guest Safety Around Equipment above.

audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: Does Malaga Event Gear check electrical load or circuit capacity before setup?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: We do not publish a wattage or amperage spec sheet for our equipment, but we do ask about your venue's power situation when you book, how many outlets are near the setup area and whether they share a circuit, so our crew can plan the load ahead of time rather than improvising on site. See Electrical Load and Circuit Safety above.

audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: Are cables a safety risk at my event?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: They can be if left loose across a walking path, which is exactly why our crew routes and secures cable, along walls and floor edges, taped flat wherever a run crosses a path, as part of every setup rather than leaving it as a separate concern.

audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.question: Does weather change how safely the equipment can be set up outdoors?
audio-visual-rental-safety-guidelines.answer: Yes, mainly around moisture near cabling and connectors, and wind affecting stand stability on grass, sand or an open terrace. We do not publish a weatherproof rating for any of our equipment, and on outdoor bookings we plan stand placement and cable routing around the actual conditions on the day rather than a fixed method regardless of weather.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: What AV equipment do I need for a wedding?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: PA sound sized to your guest count, a wireless microphone for vows and speeches, and ambient lighting. The Wedding Pack covers all three, with a technician on site. See Why the Technician Matters at a Wedding above.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a wedding?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: The Wedding Pack costs 650 euros, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. The price includes delivery, setup and teardown. See exact pricing on our packages page.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: Is a technician included for a wedding?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: Yes. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event, one of only two packages in our catalog that does.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: How many guests can the Wedding Pack support?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: Up to 80 guests. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: Do you provide a projector or screen for a wedding?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: No, the Wedding Pack does not include one. It is built around sound, lighting and microphones for the ceremony and reception.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: Do you provide wedding decor, furniture or dancefloor accessories?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: No, those are not part of our AV packages. See our wedding rentals guide for the full range beyond AV.

audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a wedding?
audio-visual-rental-for-weddings.answer: Wedding dates fill up quickly, so book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: What AV equipment do I need for a product launch?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: A laser projector and screen for the reveal, PA sound with a mixing console, and a wireless handheld microphone so the presenter can move around the product. See What a Product Launch Needs From AV above.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Do you provide an LED video wall for product launches?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: No, the Product Presentation Pack is a laser projector and screen setup, not an LED video wall. The 5000 lumen laser projector is built to stay legible in a lit room.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Can I connect my own laptop or tablet to your AV setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: Yes. We provide HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your own laptop, tablet or media player to our screen and sound system.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Is a technician included for a product launch?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: No, not on the Product Presentation Pack: the equipment is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you or your team during the event.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Do you provide staging or a riser for the product reveal?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: No, staging is not part of the Product Presentation Pack. If your launch needs a stage or riser, see our audio visual rental for gala dinners guide, which covers the MICE Pack's optional staging.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: Do you provide live streaming or video recording for a product launch?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: No, we do not provide cameras, streaming or broadcast equipment. Our setup covers the room's screen, projector and sound.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: How many microphones are included for a product launch?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: The Product Presentation Pack includes 1 wireless handheld microphone. If your launch needs more than one, let us know when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a product launch?
audio-visual-rental-for-product-launches.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a launch with a fixed reveal date, book as early as you can once your venue is confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: Is Malaga Event Gear a real, established audio visual rental company?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: Yes, operating in Malaga since 1996, with a 5.0 average across 8 Google reviews.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: Does Malaga Event Gear provide a technician, or is that extra?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: Technician inclusion follows the package you choose: the Wedding Pack and the MICE Pack both come with one built in, the Basic MICE Pack lets you add one for an extra fee, and neither the Eco Pack nor the Product Presentation Pack carries a technician.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: How much does Malaga Event Gear charge to rent AV equipment?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: Prices start at 290 euros and top out at 650 euros, ex VAT, before the 21 percent Spanish VAT is added at checkout. Delivery, setup and teardown are already built into every one of those figures. Full pricing by package is on our packages page.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: What events does Malaga Event Gear cover?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: Guest capacity scales with the package: up to 40 on the Basic MICE Pack, 50 on the Eco Pack, 80 on the Wedding Pack, and 120 on the MICE Pack.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: Does Malaga Event Gear deliver and set up the equipment, or do I collect it myself?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: We deliver, install and test every package ourselves, then collect it again after your event. This is not a self-collect model.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: What areas does Malaga Event Gear serve?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: Malaga and 23 towns across the Costa del Sol, extending to Sevilla and Granada for larger bookings.

audio-visual-rental-company.question: How far in advance should I book Malaga Event Gear?
audio-visual-rental-company.answer: A minimum of 24 hours notice guarantees your slot. We are based in Malaga, with delivery extending to Granada once the booking passes 400 euros.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: How do I know which wedding rental package I need?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: Start with guest count: up to 50 points to the Eco Pack, up to 80 points to the Wedding Pack. See Step 1 above for the full comparison table.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: Does it matter if my wedding is indoor or outdoor?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: Yes, for how the package gets set up, though not usually for which package you book. See our indoor and outdoor guides for the acoustics, power and curfew questions specific to each.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: My venue already has speakers. Do I still need to rent sound?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: Often yes, for the parts a house system usually cannot cover, wedding sized lighting, wireless microphones and a technician among them. Our tips for reducing wedding rental costs guide covers this question in full.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: Do I need a live technician, or can I run the sound myself?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: That is the same choice as Eco Pack versus Wedding Pack. The Eco Pack is self run after our crew sets it up. The Wedding Pack includes a technician throughout. See Step 4 above.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: What should I ask before I actually book a provider?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: That is a separate step from choosing a package. See our questions to ask a wedding rental company guide for the four questions worth asking any provider, including MEG.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: How far in advance should I book?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: There is no fixed rule, only availability, tightest in peak season. See our booking timeline guide.

how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.question: What if my guest count is over 80?
how-to-choose-wedding-rentals.answer: Contact us directly. Neither package is built to scale past 80 guests, and we would rather tell you that plainly than have you assume the Wedding Pack stretches further than it does.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: What AV equipment do I need for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: A gooseneck microphone for the boardroom, a projector and screen, and PA sound sized to a small group. The Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts. See A Board Meeting Is Not a Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How is a corporate meeting different from a conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: A conference needs a large room and often breakout sessions running in parallel. A board meeting, client meeting or investor panel is smaller and more routine: a boardroom or hotel suite, a fixed speaker position, no breakout rooms. See our audio visual rental for conferences guide for the larger case.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: Is a technician included for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: Not by default on the Basic MICE Pack: a technician is available as an add on. The MICE Pack includes a technician on site for up to six hours.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger meeting, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How many people can a corporate meeting AV setup accommodate?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: The Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See When to Step Up to the MICE Pack above.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: Do you provide video conferencing equipment for hybrid meetings?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: No, video conferencing hardware is not part of our catalog. If your meeting needs a remote participant joining an in-person room, see our audio visual rental for remote presentations guide instead.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a corporate meeting?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-meetin.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: What are the real advantages of renting wedding AV instead of buying it?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Professional brand name gear (Audix, QSC and Martin), a live technician included on the Wedding Pack, flat transparent pricing with delivery and teardown built in, and no equipment to store or maintain after the wedding.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: What are the real downsides of Malaga Event Gear's wedding packages?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Only two fixed guest count tiers (50 or 80, no in between sizing), delivery only with no self pickup option, no walk in showroom to test gear beforehand, and fixed prices with no negotiation or off season discount.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Is it worth buying my own PA system and lighting for a single wedding?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: For most couples, no. The upfront cost of professional grade gear rarely pays off for a single event, and there is usually no realistic plan for storing or maintaining it afterward. Renting trades that cost and burden for one flat fee.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Should I rent an AV package or hire a full production company?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: A full production company offers a larger team and fully custom staging, at a higher price than a package like the Wedding Pack. For most weddings under 80 guests, that level of customization is more than the day needs, and the Wedding Pack's fixed price and included technician cover the same core job for less.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Does the Wedding Pack include a technician, or do I run the sound myself?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event. The Eco Pack, for up to 50 guests, is self run after our crew delivers, installs and tests it, a real difference worth weighing alongside the 360 euro price gap.

pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.question: Can I negotiate the price or get a self pickup option to save money?
pros-and-cons-of-wedding-rentals.answer: No to both. MEG's package prices are fixed with no negotiation, price matching or off season discount, and we operate delivery only with no self pickup option under any circumstances.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: How much does audio visual hire cost near me?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Eco Pack for small private parties up to the MICE Pack for large conferences, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: What is included in an audio visual hire package?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: Every package includes delivery, professional setup, testing and teardown, so you never handle the equipment yourself. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack also include a technician on site for the hours that matter. See the exact inclusions per package on our packages page.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: What is the difference between dry hire and full service AV hire?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: Dry hire is equipment only, with no delivery, setup or technician. We do not operate that way: every Malaga Event Gear package is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, and collected again afterward. See Dry Hire vs. Full Service AV Hire above.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: How many guests can your AV packages support?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: It scales with the package: the Eco Pack covers up to 50 guests, the Wedding Pack up to 80, the Basic MICE Pack up to 40, and the MICE Pack up to 120. See the full comparison in Comprehensive Audio Visual Packages for Every Event above.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: Can audio visual equipment be used outdoors?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: Yes. We regularly set up sound and lighting for beach ceremonies, villa terraces and rooftop events across the Costa del Sol. For setup specifics, see Audio Visual Rental for Outdoor Events.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: What is the difference between hiring AV equipment and hiring a DJ?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: A DJ hire covers music and a DJ console. AV hire covers what a DJ alone does not: PA sound reinforcement, presentation screens, and wireless or gooseneck microphones for speeches. Our packages combine both where an event needs it, such as a wedding with a DJ set and speeches running through the same sound system.

audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.question: Do you serve areas outside Malaga city?
audio-visual-hire-near-me-in-malaga-spai.answer: Yes. We deliver across the wider Costa del Sol, including Marbella, Fuengirola, Torremolinos, Benalmadena, Estepona, Mijas, Nerja and Antequera, with wider reach to Sevilla and Granada. See Costa del Sol Coverage, Not Just Malaga City above.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: What AV equipment do I need for a press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: A podium microphone, PA sound that reaches the room, and a screen for branding or slides. The Basic MICE Pack covers a smaller press conference; the MICE Pack covers a larger one with a technician included. See Press Conference vs. General Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Do you provide a camera riser or platform for press photographers?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: We don't supply cameras, but our staging add on on the MICE Pack can be positioned as a riser or platform for photographers and camera operators.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: How many microphones do I need for a press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: The Basic MICE Pack includes 1 gooseneck microphone for the podium. The MICE Pack includes a gooseneck plus a wireless handheld microphone, useful if a panel of speakers or a Q&A needs to pass the mic around.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Do you provide a press mult box or individual audio feeds for reporters?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: No, a mult box to distribute the podium audio to multiple reporters' recorders is not part of our catalog. Press typically bring and manage their own recording equipment at the podium.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Does the AV company provide a branded backdrop or step-and-repeat banner?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: No, a backdrop or banner is usually sourced through your PR or marketing team. We set up the podium, sound and staging it stands in front of.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: Do you provide live streaming, broadcast feed or video recording?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: No, we do not provide cameras, streaming or broadcast equipment. Our setup covers the room's sound, screen and staging.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.question: How many people can a press conference AV setup accommodate?
audio-visual-rental-for-press-conference.answer: The Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: What AV equipment is needed for a conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: A typical conference needs PA sound reinforcement, a projector or LED display for slides, and wired, wireless or gooseneck microphones for the podium and panel discussions. Larger conferences with breakout rooms need a second, smaller setup for each parallel session.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How much does audio visual rental for a conference cost?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack for a small executive session up to the MICE Pack for a full conference, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How is a conference AV setup different from a corporate event or press conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: A corporate event is usually a single room with one setup. A press conference is built around one speaker area and a podium mic. A conference is the more demanding case: a plenary session plus one or more breakout rooms running in parallel, each needing its own sound and screen. See How This Differs from a Corporate Event or Press Conference above.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: Can you run AV for a plenary session and breakout rooms on the same day?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: Yes. The MICE Pack covers the plenary with a technician on site, and the Basic MICE Pack covers a smaller breakout or executive session. Book both together for a multi-room conference day.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a conference?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: Book as early as you can once your date and room layout are confirmed, especially if your conference needs both a plenary and breakout rooms covered on the same day. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during the spring and autumn conference season.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: What services does Malaga Event Gear provide for conferences in Malaga?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: We deliver, install and test sound, projection, LED display and lighting for conferences across Malaga and the wider Costa del Sol, with a technician on site on the MICE Pack.

audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.question: How can I book audiovisual services with Malaga Event Gear?
audio-visual-rental-for-conferences.answer: Visit our packages page to compare packages, or reach out via our contact page to discuss your conference and get a tailored quote. We are available daily from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm.

audio-visual-rental.question: What types of events does Malaga Event Gear cater to?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Malaga Event Gear specializes in providing audio visual rental services for an array of events such as weddings, corporate meetings, private parties, and seminars.

audio-visual-rental.question: What is the MICE Pack offered by Malaga Event Gear?
audio-visual-rental.answer: The MICE Pack is a comprehensive audiovisual setup ideal for corporate meetings, conferences, and exhibitions. It includes top notch equipment such as a 60 inch screen, a high quality sound system, and various microphone options.

audio-visual-rental.question: How does Malaga Event Gear ensure a seamless event experience?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Our dedicated team at Malaga Event Gear provides tailored service, assisting with setup and operation of audiovisual equipment, ensuring seamless integration of dynamic lighting and sound solutions for a flawless event execution.

audio-visual-rental.question: What makes Malaga Event Gear's wedding and Eco Packs unique?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Our Wedding and Eco Packs feature dynamic lighting and advanced sound systems that transform any venue into a breathtaking space, ensuring unforgettable audio and visual experiences for your celebration.

audio-visual-rental.question: How can I book audiovisual equipment from Malaga Event Gear?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Booking with Malaga Event Gear is straightforward. Visit our website, select your rental options, fill out our booking form with your event details, and our team will confirm your booking for a hassle-free experience.

audio-visual-rental.question: How much does audio visual rental cost in Malaga?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Eco Pack for small private parties up to the MICE Pack for large conferences, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental.question: What audio visual equipment can I rent from Malaga Event Gear?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Our catalog covers active PA sound systems, Full HD laser projectors and screens, a premium 60 inch LED display, RGBW LED lighting and fairy light strings, plus wired, wireless and gooseneck microphones. See the full breakdown in Audio Visual Equipment We Rent in Malaga above.

audio-visual-rental.question: What areas does Malaga Event Gear serve?
audio-visual-rental.answer: We are based in Malaga and serve the wider Costa del Sol, including Marbella, Fuengirola, Torremolinos, Benalmadena, Estepona and Mijas, with wider coverage reaching Sevilla, Granada, Ronda, Nerja and Antequera.

audio-visual-rental.question: How far in advance should I book audio visual equipment in Malaga?
audio-visual-rental.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date is confirmed. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during wedding season, from April through October, when technicians and the most requested packages fill up first. Corporate bookings tied to a fixed conference date should also lock in the package early rather than wait for a final headcount.

audio-visual-rental.question: What is the difference between renting AV equipment and hiring a full production company?
audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the event. Our Eco Pack is a delivery, setup and teardown service for private parties, no technician required. For weddings and corporate events, packages like the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack add a live technician on site for the hours that matter, closing the gap between a bare equipment rental and hiring a separate production company. See Rental vs. Full Production Company above.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: What items does Malaga Event Gear actually provide for a wedding?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: PA sound, ambient lighting, wireless microphones and a live technician, bundled in the Wedding Pack for 650 euros ex VAT. We do not supply furniture, tents, linens, catering or decor.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Does the Wedding Pack include chairs, tables or linens?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: No. Those come from a furniture rental company or, in many cases, are already included in the venue's own hire.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Do venues around Malaga usually include furniture in the hire?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Many fincas and villas on the Costa del Sol bundle a base level of furniture into the venue rental itself. This varies by venue, so confirm directly with yours before renting furniture separately.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Should ceremony microphones be wired or wireless?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Wired is usually safer for the officiant during vows, since it removes any risk of a dropped wireless signal at the one moment of the day that cannot be redone. Wireless suits reception speeches and toasts, where guests move between the microphone and their seats.

essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.question: Is ceremony sound the same setup as reception sound?
essential-items-for-wedding-rentals.answer: No. Ceremony sound is tuned for clarity at a lower volume for a seated audience. Reception sound covers speeches at similar clarity, then switches to music at dance volume, a different tuning task our live technician adjusts for throughout the event.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: How much does wedding lighting rental cost?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: MEG's wedding lighting comes bundled inside two packages rather than sold separately. The Wedding Pack includes fairy lights and warm LED strings for 650 euros ex VAT, and the Eco Pack includes RGBW spotlights for 290 euros ex VAT. Both prices cover the full package, sound and microphones included, not lighting alone.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: What's the difference between uplighting and spotlighting?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Uplighting sits on the floor and washes light upward against a wall or structure. Spotlighting aims a narrow beam at a specific point, like a table or the couple. We stock both: a wireless uplighting kit of 6 fixtures as a separate quote on request item, and the Eco Pack's RGBW light bars for a fixed position spotlight and color accent. Neither is bundled into the Wedding Pack, so contact us if your reception needs uplighting alongside it. For the full spec on that kit, honest coverage for 2 to 4 venue features, and a direct comparison against these RGBW spotlights, see our stage uplighting guide.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Can wedding lighting include gobo or monogram projection?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Not through MEG. Gobo and monogram projection, casting a couple's initials or a pattern onto a wall or floor, isn't part of either package. If that's specifically what you're after, it needs a separate specialty lighting vendor. Our essential items for wedding rentals guide covers the full line of what MEG does and doesn't rent.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Where should fairy lights be placed at an outdoor wedding?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Pergola beams, trees along a walkway, and directly over a reception area are the three placements that come up most at Malaga area venues. Wind and what the structure can actually hold decide the exact anchoring on the day, which our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide covers in more depth for the rest of the outdoor setup.

lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.question: Does any MEG lighting change color for the dance floor?
lighting-ideas-for-wedding-rentals.answer: Yes, but only on the Eco Pack, whose RGBW light bars produce color changing light suited to a dance floor. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights and warm LED strings stay a fixed warm tone and don't change color, an important distinction if a color changing dance floor look is specifically what you want.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: What AV equipment do I need for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: It depends on the moment: a wireless microphone for the emcee and speeches, sound for the room, and staging if the evening includes a live auction. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Wedding Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger fundraising gala, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: What size fundraiser does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: The Wedding Pack covers up to 80 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See Match Your Fundraiser to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Do you provide staging for a live auction?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, on the MICE Pack, modular staging and a methacrylate lectern are available as add ons for a live auction or emcee segment.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Can you display the current bid or a donor recognition slide?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, the MICE Pack includes a 60 inch LED display that can show a bid, a donor recognition slide or event branding.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: Is a technician included for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Yes, both the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site, so a dropped microphone connection during the auction gets fixed immediately.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a charity fundraiser?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a larger fundraiser with multiple moments to coordinate, such as speeches, an auction and entertainment, book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.question: How long has Malaga Event Gear been providing audio visual rental?
audio-visual-rental-for-charity-fundrais.answer: Malaga Event Gear has been running live events across Malaga and the Costa del Sol since 1996, three decades of hands-on experience.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack for a club event up to the MICE Pack for a full tournament, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What AV equipment do I need for a sports event's announcer PA?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: An announcer PA needs active PA sound reinforcement sized to carry over crowd noise, plus a wired, wireless or gooseneck microphone for the announcer or match commentator. See AV Built for Match Day above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Can outdoor sports events use the same AV equipment as indoor venues?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Our PA sound, lighting and staging all travel to outdoor pitches, courts and tracks. The real constraint is power: tell us what mains power is available at your outdoor venue when you book, so we can size the setup correctly. See Outdoor Setups above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Do you provide microphones for match commentary or medal ceremonies?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Yes. We provide wired, wireless and gooseneck microphones for match commentary, team introductions and sponsor speeches, plus a methacrylate lectern for medal ceremonies and opening remarks.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What size screen or projector is best for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Our 60 inch LED display, on the MICE Pack, suits a larger tournament venue; our 3000 lumen projector and screen, on the Basic MICE Pack, suits a mid-size venue. Tell us your venue size when you book and we will match the right screen.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: Is a smoke machine available for team walkouts or ceremony openings?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Yes, our smoke machine is available as an add on on the Eco Pack, for team walkouts and ceremony openings. See Staging for Medal Ceremonies and Team Walkouts above.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a sports event?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed, especially for a tournament with a ceremony on a fixed schedule. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during the spring and autumn sports season.

audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.question: What sports events has Malaga Event Gear worked on before?
audio-visual-rental-for-sports-events.answer: We delivered the full lights and sound setup for the Billie Jean King Cup 2024, including the awards ceremony. See the Case Study above.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: How far in advance should I book audio visual rental in Malaga?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: There is no fixed rule or calendar table. What actually matters is confirming your guest count against a package's real capacity, and reaching out early enough that the equipment, and a technician if your package includes one, is still free for your date. See The First Real Decision above.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: Does booking earlier get me a better price?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: No. Every package carries one flat, ex VAT price regardless of how far ahead you book. Booking earlier protects availability, particularly for the technician included with the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, it does not lower what you pay. See What Does Not Change above.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: What information do you need from me to send a quote?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: Your event date, the venue location, your expected guest count, and which package interests you. Those 4 details let us confirm equipment and technician availability in one exchange. See What We Need From You above.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: Can I add equipment or technician hours after I have already booked?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: Yes, an add on request is possible, but it still has to clear the same 24 hour minimum notice as a first booking, and it is confirmed against whatever equipment or technician time is actually still available for your date, not guaranteed on request. See The One Hard Deadline above.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: Is there a deposit or contract before my date is secured?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: We do not publish a deposit or contract policy for AV equipment. Your date is confirmed through the same 4 step process described above, quote request, our team finalizing details, and confirmation, not a separate deposit or signed contract step. If a specific arrangement matters to your planning, ask us directly at the quote stage.

audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.question: What is the minimum notice period for a booking or a change?
audio-visual-rental-planning-timeline.answer: 24 hours, for any event gear rental or technical service, and for any change to a booking already made. There is no shorter or longer version of this rule for larger or smaller events. See The One Hard Deadline above.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: What is actually trending in wedding rentals right now?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: Most "wedding rental trend" content covers decor, tablescapes, and catering, none of which MEG offers. On our own AV side, the real pattern is more couples booking the technician included Wedding Pack over a self run setup, and wireless microphones becoming a default expectation for reception speeches rather than a special request.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Is a live wedding AV technician a standard trend now, or still optional?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and the full MICE Pack include a live technician on site throughout the event. The Basic MICE Pack does not include one by default, but it can be added from 240 euros per day. The Eco Pack is delivered and tested by our crew, then run without a technician for the rest of the event. See our making the most of your wedding rentals guide for how to brief the technician once you've booked.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Are couples choosing warm static lighting or color changing lighting more often for weddings?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: Both, depending on guest count and the look they want. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights give a fixed warm glow for up to 80 guests. The Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights give color changing accents for up to 50 guests. Neither is a default over the other. Our lighting ideas for wedding rentals guide has the full comparison.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: Does Malaga Event Gear offer an eco friendly or sustainable rental option?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: The Eco Pack is our smallest, simplest setup, two speakers, one microphone, two light bars, self run after our crew delivers and tests it. It's a genuinely smaller footprint installation for smaller events, but it is not a certified sustainability program, and we don't market it as one.

latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.question: What equipment brands does MEG use for wedding AV rentals?
latest-trends-in-wedding-rentals.answer: We use premium professional brands trusted in the live event industry, including Audix, QSC, and Martin, across both the Wedding Pack and the Eco Pack, to ensure reliable, high fidelity sound and lighting performance.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: What is the difference between a headset and a lavalier microphone?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: A lavalier clips to clothing and stays out of sight, which suits photography and video, but its distance from the mouth is fixed by where it clips and it is more prone to feedback at higher volumes. A headset, our AUDIX HT5, curves from behind the ear to sit a fixed, close distance from the mouth, so the level stays consistent even when the wearer turns or gestures, at the cost of being visible on camera. See Lavalier or Headset above.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: Do you rent headset or lavalier microphones with the Wedding Pack?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: Not as an inclusion. The Wedding Pack includes a wireless handheld microphone as standard. A wireless lavalier set or the AUDIX HT5 headband mic is available as a separate, quote based add on for an officiant or a second presenter who needs their hands free. See our unique wedding ceremony rentals guide for the officiant specific detail.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: Can a corporate presenter use a lavalier or headset mic with the MICE Pack?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: Yes, as an add on. The MICE Pack includes a gooseneck and a wireless handheld microphone as standard, with a technician on site for up to 6 continuous hours. A lavalier or the AUDIX HT5 headband mic can be added on top of that for a presenter who wants to leave the podium and gesture freely. Contact us with your event details to confirm availability.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: How much does it cost to rent a lavalier or headset microphone?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: We do not publish a fixed a la carte price for either. Neither is bundled into the Eco Pack, Basic MICE Pack, Wedding Pack or MICE Pack, so contact us with your package and guest count and we will confirm a quote.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: How many wireless lavalier microphones do you have available?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: Two complete AUDIX RAD-360 wireless lavalier sets, each with its own receiver, bodypack transmitter, lavalier capsule and antennas, so two people can wear one at the same time. We also stock one AUDIX HT5 wireless headband mic, a separate item from the lavalier sets. We do not offer a third simultaneous hands free channel today.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: Is a lavalier or headset microphone better for a wedding officiant?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: Usually a lavalier, since it stays out of sight in ceremony photos and video, and most officiants stand in roughly one spot rather than pacing a stage. The AUDIX HT5 headband mic is visible on camera, which is why it suits a corporate presenter who moves more than it suits a ceremony. Tell us your officiant's preference when you book. See our essential items for wedding rentals guide for how this fits into the rest of the Wedding Pack.

headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.question: Can a panel or Q&A session share a lavalier or headset setup between speakers?
headset-lavalier-microphone-rental.answer: Two panelists can each wear a complete AUDIX RAD-360 lavalier set at the same time, while the moderator or additional speakers use the package's included wireless handheld microphone for audience questions. That is the real limit of our current inventory, two simultaneous lavalier channels, not more.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: How does audio visual equipment work?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Audio visual systems combine sound and visual technology: microphones and playback devices as inputs, mixers and amplifiers to process the signal, and speakers, projectors or displays as outputs, all working together to reach your audience.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Is it cheaper to rent or buy a sound system?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Renting is generally more cost effective for a single event or occasional use, since it avoids the maintenance and storage costs of owning equipment you rarely use. Our Eco Pack covers a small private event with sound, microphone and lighting included, delivered and collected for you.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: What is the audio visual rental process step by step?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Get a quote from our packages page, confirm your booking, and our crew handles delivery, installation and testing on the day. On packages with a technician, they stay on site during your event, then our crew returns afterward to collect everything. See The Rental Process, Step by Step above.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Is setup and teardown included in the price, or is it extra?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Setup and teardown are always included in the price shown on our packages page. This is a full service delivery model: our crew installs, tests and collects the equipment, you never do it yourself.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Why is technical support important during events with AV rentals?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: A technician on site means a dropped microphone connection or a projector that will not sync gets fixed immediately, not after your event has already suffered for it. Whether a technician is included depends on your package: see Technician Support above.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: What types of events are suitable for audio visual rentals?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Audio visual rental suits weddings, corporate meetings and conferences, private parties, and product presentations, with a package sized to each: from the Eco Pack for a small private party up to the MICE Pack for a full conference.

how-audio-visual-rental-works.question: Can I change or cancel my AV rental booking?
how-audio-visual-rental-works.answer: Contact us as soon as you know about a change or cancellation, and we will do our best to accommodate it. Reach out via our contact page to discuss your specific booking.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Does a technician stay on site to react if the weather changes during my event?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Only on the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, which include a live technician throughout the event who can reposition equipment, add moisture protection to cables, or adjust for wind as conditions change. The Eco Pack and Basic MICE Pack are self run after our crew installs and tests the system, so nobody is there to react afterward.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Is your AV equipment weatherproof?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: We do not publish a weatherproof rating for any of our equipment. Wireless microphone receivers are moisture sensitive and can drop signal, cabling and connectors are an electrical safety risk in wet conditions, and heat affects the electronics in active PA systems and LED lighting over a long outdoor run. A live technician, where one is included, is what actually manages that risk in real time.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Do you supply tents, canopies or generators for outdoor weather protection?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: No. We do not stock tents, canopies, marquees, generators, portable air conditioning or heaters. Venue provided shelter and power need to be confirmed by you directly with your venue. Tell us what is available when you book so our technician can plan the AV setup around it.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: If the forecast changes close to my event date, how much flexibility do I have?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: All bookings and changes to one need at least 24 hours' notice to guarantee scheduling and logistical availability. Checking the forecast a week out leaves real room to adjust your package or add ons. Checking it inside that 24 hour window still gets an availability check, not a guarantee. See our managing last minute wedding rental changes guide for the full mechanics.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: Who handles the equipment if it rains, me or your crew?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Our crew. We operate delivery only, there is no self pickup option, so our own trained team transports, installs and retrieves every system regardless of weather, rather than a client handling the gear themselves.

weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.question: How does wind affect where you place speakers and lighting outdoors?
weather-considerations-for-outdoor-renta.answer: Wind changes where a speaker stand or lighting rig can safely stand on grass, sand or a windy terrace. Our technician reads the actual ground and wind exposure on site. Our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide covers this in more depth for wedding venues specifically.

video-switcher-rental.question: What is a video switcher, and what does MEG's video switcher rental include?
video-switcher-rental.answer: A video switcher cuts a screen cleanly between more than one presentation source instead of forcing a manual cable swap. MEG's real version of this is one Kramer VP-731, a 9 input video scaler and switcher, operated by our technician rather than rented as a self run box. See The Real Unit We Stock above for exactly what it is and is not.

video-switcher-rental.question: Is this the same as a camera switcher or a live streaming production switcher?
video-switcher-rental.answer: No. This is the single most important distinction on this page. Our Kramer VP-731 switches presentation sources, a laptop, a second laptop, a DVD player, onto your room's own screen. It does not accept camera inputs and it is not built for live streaming or broadcast production. Malaga Event Gear does not offer camera equipment, video recording, live streaming or broadcast services of any kind. See Video Switcher vs Camera Switcher above.

video-switcher-rental.question: How many sources can it switch between?
video-switcher-rental.answer: The unit has 9 physical inputs, but the honest, typical use case on our real bookings is 2 to 3 sources, a laptop, a second laptop and occasionally a DVD player, not 9 at once. See What 9 Inputs Actually Means in Practice above.

video-switcher-rental.question: Can I rent just the switcher without a technician?
video-switcher-rental.answer: No. This is technician operated equipment, consistent with our delivery only model, we do not offer self collect or self run rentals of any kind. On the Basic MICE Pack, adding the video switcher requires the on site live technical assistant add on. On the MICE Pack, the included technician manages it as part of the standard booking.

video-switcher-rental.question: Video switcher vs camera or vision mixer for live streaming, what is the real difference?
video-switcher-rental.answer: A video switcher like ours cuts between presentation sources for a room's own screen, a laptop to a laptop to a DVD player. A camera or vision mixer for live streaming accepts multiple camera feeds and produces a program output for a broadcast or a stream to remote viewers, an entirely different category of equipment with a different signal chain. MEG stocks the first and does not offer the second: no cameras, no recording, no live streaming or broadcast services. If your event needs a filmed record or a stream to remote attendees, tell us directly and we will confirm plainly that it is not something we provide.

video-switcher-rental.question: Which packages include this, and how much does it cost?
video-switcher-rental.answer: None of our four packages include it as standard. It realistically pairs with the MICE Pack, which already includes a screen and a technician, or the Basic MICE Pack with its technical assistant add on, since this is technician operated equipment. There is no published a la carte price. Contact us with your package and agenda and we will confirm availability and a quote. See Which Packages This Is Available On above.

video-switcher-rental.question: What sources can it actually switch between?
video-switcher-rental.answer: Confirmed, real sources: a laptop, a second laptop, and a DVD player, drawn from an LG-RH7500 DVD recorder and hard disk unit in our inventory. We do not stock a document camera or a visualizer, so we will not offer one as a source if your event asks for it.

video-switcher-rental.question: Do you rent the DVD recorder, or other recording equipment, separately from the switcher?
video-switcher-rental.answer: No. The LG-RH7500 DVD recorder and hard disk unit is one of the switcher's three confirmed sources, not a standalone rental item, and it has no camera input. If you are searching for recording equipment rental meaning cameras, lenses, or production gear to film your event, that is not something MEG offers: we are an audio, screen, and lighting rental company for events, not a camera or video production equipment supplier. Tell us directly if that is what you need and we will confirm plainly that it is outside what we provide.

video-switcher-rental.question: Do I need this for a small event, or only for larger corporate bookings?
video-switcher-rental.answer: Only if your event has more than one presentation source on the same screen. A single speaker with one slide deck does not need it, a single laptop connection is genuinely simpler. It becomes relevant on a conference agenda with more than one presenter, or a keynote that includes a video insert, which is why it shows up almost exclusively on our corporate MICE bookings rather than private parties.

video-switcher-rental.question: How does this compare to just using one laptop for my presentation?
video-switcher-rental.answer: A single laptop is simpler and needs nothing extra, and it is the right choice if your event genuinely has one presenter and one deck. The difference shows up the moment a second source enters the picture, a second speaker's laptop or a screened video clip. Without the switcher, that source change means unplugging and reconnecting a cable live, with a visible black screen or reboot. With it, our technician cuts between sources with no visible interruption. See Video Switcher or a Single Presentation Source above for the full comparison.

video-switcher-rental.question: Can I bring my own devices to switch between?
video-switcher-rental.answer: Yes, within the confirmed source types, a laptop or a second laptop connects the same way any presentation laptop does on our packages, through the HDMI and USB-C adapters we already provide. Tell us what devices your event will actually use when you book so our technician can confirm compatibility and the connection setup ahead of time, rather than troubleshoot it live.

video-switcher-rental.question: How far in advance should I book this?
video-switcher-rental.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date, venue and agenda are confirmed. See How Far in Advance to Book above. Because it is a single unit that requires a technician, confirming early matters more here than on equipment we stock in larger quantities.

audio-system-calibration.question: What is audio system calibration, in plain terms?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Setting every microphone and speaker to the specific room your event is in, rather than plugging equipment in and turning it on. It covers gain staging on each input, speaker placement, and console settings, all adjusted to that room's acoustics, not a fixed configuration brought from the last event. See What Audio System Calibration Actually Means above.

audio-system-calibration.question: What is gain staging, and why does it matter?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Gain staging is setting each microphone's input level correctly at the source, before it reaches the console's main volume. Too low, and the signal sounds weak and picks up background noise once the volume is pushed up to compensate. Too high, and it distorts the moment a presenter raises their voice. See Gain Staging in Plain Terms above.

audio-system-calibration.question: Why does the same equipment need different calibration at different venues?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Room acoustics change what correct calibration looks like even with identical gear. A low ceiling and hard surfaces, tile, glass, bare stone, reflect sound back quickly and raise feedback risk, so gain runs lower and speaker angles are set more carefully than in a taller room with soft, sound absorbing furnishings. See Why Every Venue Needs Different Calibration above.

audio-system-calibration.question: Does an outdoor venue get calibrated differently than an indoor one?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Yes. Outdoor venues have no walls to reflect sound back the way indoor rooms do, so speakers get placed closer to the audience and gain often runs higher for the same coverage, since there is no reflected sound filling gaps between speaker positions. See Indoor, Outdoor and Guest Count above.

audio-system-calibration.question: Does guest count affect calibration, and if so how?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Yes. A full room of guests, their bodies and clothing, absorbs sound differently than the same room empty during setup. That is why our crew tests as close to your doors opening as practically possible rather than calibrating hours ahead in an empty room. See Indoor, Outdoor and Guest Count above.

audio-system-calibration.question: What mixing console does MEG use for calibration, and does it depend on the package?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Yes, it scales with event size: a 6 channel Soundcraft EPM-6 for smaller bookings with a console, such as the Product Presentation Pack, a 16 channel Mackie Onyx 1640 for mid size corporate events, and a Midas M32R Live with an MD16 digital stage box on larger venues, up to the MICE Pack's 120 guests. The Eco Pack itself has no console at all. See Same Real Equipment, Calibrated for Scale above.

audio-system-calibration.question: What is the Midas M32R Live and MD16 stage box, and when does MEG use it?
audio-system-calibration.answer: The Midas M32R Live is our digital mixing console for larger venues, paired with an MD16, a remote stage box that converts each microphone to digital right at the stage and carries every channel back to the console over a single cable, instead of a long bundle of individual microphone cables. We use this pairing on larger bookings, the scale our MICE Pack serves up to 120 guests. See The Midas M32R Live and MD16 above.

audio-system-calibration.question: Does calibration include video or screen setup too?
audio-system-calibration.answer: No, not on this page. Audio calibration, gain staging and speaker tuning, is a separate process from screen and presentation source switching, which our Kramer VP-731 handles. If your event's account mentions calibrating "sound and video networks" together, the video half refers to that presentation scaler, not a camera or broadcast system, which we do not offer. See Calibration in the Field above.

audio-system-calibration.question: Is calibration done once, or does it change during the event?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Calibration itself happens once, before your guests arrive, setting the baseline for your event. What can change afterward, a cable getting knocked loose or a gain fader nudged, is a separate question on the self run packages where no technician is watching the levels. On packages with a technician, live monitoring keeps adjusting from that calibrated baseline as your event runs.

audio-system-calibration.question: Do I need to be there while my equipment is calibrated?
audio-system-calibration.answer: No. Our crew calibrates every booking before you or your guests arrive, as part of the delivery, install and test process on every package. You do not need to be present for it, though you are welcome to be if your schedule allows.

audio-system-calibration.question: How far in advance does calibration happen relative to my event start time?
audio-system-calibration.answer: Our crew arrives and calibrates ahead of your first guest, timed close enough to your doors opening that guest count and room absorption are accounted for, not hours earlier when the room is still empty. See Indoor, Outdoor and Guest Count and How Far in Advance to Book above for what that means for booking lead time.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Is it cheaper to rent or buy AV equipment?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: For most one-off or occasional events, renting is cheaper: our packages start at 290 euros, ex VAT, with delivery, setup and teardown included, versus a large upfront purchase plus storage and maintenance between uses.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: What is included in an AV rental price?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Delivery, professional setup, testing and teardown, on every package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack also include a technician on site. See exact inclusions per package on our packages page.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Do I need to store or maintain the equipment myself?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: No. Our crew delivers the equipment before your event and collects it afterward, so you never store, transport or maintain it between events.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: Is a technician included, or do I run the equipment myself?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site. On other packages, a technician is available as an add on, or the equipment is delivered ready to run yourself.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How do I know which package fits my event?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: It depends on the event type and guest count: an Eco Pack for a small private party, a Wedding Pack for a wedding, a Product Presentation or Basic MICE Pack for a corporate meeting, or a MICE Pack for a larger conference or gala. See Flexibility for Different Events above.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How much does audio visual rental cost in Malaga?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Our packages range from 290 euros for the Eco Pack to 650 euros for the Wedding Pack, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. See live pricing for every package on our packages page.

benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.question: How far in advance should I book audio visual rental?
benefits-of-audio-visual-rental.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

projector-rental.question: Can I rent just a projection screen, without a projector?
projector-rental.answer: No. We do not sell a projection screen on its own. Every screen we deploy is bundled with a projector sized to it, whether that is the Eco Pack's 50 euro add on or the fixed screen and projector inclusion on the Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack. See Why the Screen Is Always Bundled With the Projector above.

projector-rental.question: Is a screen included with the projector, or sold separately?
projector-rental.answer: Included, always. The Eco Pack bundles "projector & projection screen" as one 50 euro add on line. The Basic MICE Pack includes a 2x2m screen with its 3000 lumen projector. The Product Presentation Pack includes a front projection screen with a stable stand alongside its 5000 lumen laser projector. We do not sell either piece on its own.

projector-rental.question: What's the largest screen size available?
projector-rental.answer: 2x2 meters, on the Basic MICE Pack. We do not publish a larger a la carte screen size.

projector-rental.question: What brightness or lumens do I need for a daylit or brightly lit room?
projector-rental.answer: For a standard boardroom or a room you can dim, the 3000 lumen projector on the Basic MICE Pack is the right tier. For a room that stays lit, such as a dealership showroom during a launch or a press event with photographers, the 5000 lumen Full HD laser projector on the Product Presentation Pack is built for that. See Choosing a Lumens Tier for Your Room above.

projector-rental.question: Do you offer 4K or laser projectors?
projector-rental.answer: Laser, yes: the Product Presentation Pack uses a 5000 lumen Full HD laser projector. We do not publish 4K resolution on either projector tier we offer.

projector-rental.question: Can you project onto a building facade or do outdoor projection mapping?
projector-rental.answer: No. Facade projection and outdoor projection mapping fall outside our current catalog. Our projector and screen setups are built for indoor presentations, conferences and product showcases, not building scale outdoor projection.

projector-rental.question: Is setup and installation included?
projector-rental.answer: Yes, on every package. Our crew delivers, installs and tests the projector and screen before your event starts, then returns afterward to collect everything, the same delivery, install, test and collect model we use across our full catalog.

projector-rental.question: How much does a projector rental cost?
projector-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack is 290 euros base, plus a 50 euro add on for the projector and screen. The Basic MICE Pack, which bundles the projector and screen as standard, is 295 euros. The Product Presentation Pack, with its 5000 lumen laser projector, is 310 euros. All prices are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. See Projector and Screen Pricing by Package above.

projector-rental.question: How far in advance should I book a projector rental?
projector-rental.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during wedding season, from April through October, and corporate bookings tied to a fixed conference or launch date should lock in early. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

projector-rental.question: Can I connect my own laptop or tablet to the projector?
projector-rental.answer: Yes. On the Product Presentation Pack, we provide HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces so your own laptop, tablet or media player connects to our screen and sound system without a last minute cable scramble.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: What should an itemized wedding AV rental quote include?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: Guest capacity, what the sound system and lighting actually are, how many microphones and what kind, whether a technician is included, whether transport, setup and teardown are bundled in, the net price, and VAT shown separately. See the checklist above for how MEG's own packages answer each one.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Does the price include delivery and setup, or are those separate line items?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: On both of MEG's wedding sized packages, transport, setup and teardown are included in the listed price rather than billed separately. Confirm this on any other quote you're comparing, since it is often billed apart elsewhere.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Does the quoted price include VAT?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: No. MEG's listed prices are ex 21 percent VAT, and the final quote shows the net price and the VAT separately. A quote that does not state this either way is worth asking about directly.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Is a technician included, or is that a separate line item?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: It depends on the package, which is exactly why it belongs on the checklist. MEG's Wedding Pack includes a live technician throughout the event. The Eco Pack does not, and is self run after our crew delivers, installs and tests it.

how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.question: Why do two quotes for what looks like the same package land at different prices?
how-to-compare-wedding-rental-quotes.answer: Almost always one of four things: a different guest capacity rating, whether a technician is included, whether VAT is already in the number, or whether setup and teardown are bundled in or billed separately. See the section above for how to tell which one is driving the gap.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: What AV equipment do I need for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: It depends on the moment: ambient lighting and sound for the reception, a wireless microphone for speeches and toasts, and staging for an awards presentation. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack cover these needs at different guest counts.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Wedding Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger awards gala, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: What size gala does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: The Wedding Pack covers up to 80 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. See Match Your Gala to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: Do you provide staging for an awards presentation?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Yes, on the MICE Pack, modular staging and a methacrylate lectern are available as add ons for an awards presentation or formal remarks.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: Is a technician included for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Yes, both the Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a technician on site, so a dropped microphone connection or a lighting cue that misses gets fixed immediately.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a gala dinner?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. For a larger gala with multiple moments to coordinate, such as speeches, an awards segment and entertainment, book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.question: How long has Malaga Event Gear been providing audio visual rental?
audio-visual-rental-for-gala-dinners.answer: Backed by experience going back to 1996, three decades of live events across Malaga and the Costa del Sol.

event-technology-service.question: What Is "Event Technology" and What Does MEG Actually Provide?
event-technology-service.answer: At Malaga Event Gear, event technology means the physical layer of an event: RGBW and specialty stage lighting, modular stage platforms, and an on site technician. It does not mean streaming, video mapping or interactive software, which some local competitors market under the same name. See Why "Event Technology" Means Something Different Here above.

event-technology-service.question: Is Event Technology the Same as Audiovisual Equipment Rental?
event-technology-service.answer: They overlap but are not identical. Our audio visual rental pillar covers the full package range, from the Eco Pack up to the MICE Pack, and our audiovisual equipment rental service pillar indexes the specialized equipment layer inside that catalog. This page is narrower still: it covers only the pieces of that catalog that fit an "event technology" framing, lighting, staging and on site support, and says plainly what falls outside it.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Event Lighting Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: Yes. RGBW LED spotlights on the Eco Pack, plus a compact multi head LED light bar, a Fresnel zoom wash light and a wireless uplighting kit for larger corporate stages, quoted on request. See Event Lighting above.

event-technology-service.question: What Is Stage Design and Setup, and Do You Offer It?
event-technology-service.answer: We offer modular stage platforms on the MICE Pack at 35 euros per square meter, sized to your room. We do not offer scenic theatrical stage design, truss rigs, or pipe and drape. See Stage Design and Setup above.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide On Site Technical Support?
event-technology-service.answer: Yes, on several packages. Our AV technician hire guide covers exactly which packages include a technician and how many hours each one covers, rather than repeating that detail here.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Offer Live Streaming or Event Technology for Hybrid or Virtual Events?
event-technology-service.answer: No. Our audio visual rental for virtual events guide states it directly: we do not supply cameras, streaming encoders, or a recording service. You bring your own laptop, conferencing software and internet connection, and we supply the room's sound and screen.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Video Mapping or LED and Video Walls?
event-technology-service.answer: No. Our large format display is a single 60 inch flat panel, not a modular tiled video wall, and our projector setups do not include facade projection or outdoor mapping. See What We Don't Offer above.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Offer Interactive Touchscreens, Kiosks or Audience Response Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: Touchscreens and kiosks, no: our audio visual rental for religious events guide rules those out on the same grounds it rules out a video wall. Audience response or voting systems, yes as an arranged service: we don't stock the hardware ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner for corporate and congress grade events.

event-technology-service.question: Do You Provide Event Apps, RFID Tracking or Ticketing Technology?
event-technology-service.answer: No. This is a scope boundary, not a gap we are hiding. It also sits outside what the local event technology competitors we looked at for this page actually sell, since they are physical AV and production companies rather than registration or ticketing platforms.

event-technology-service.question: How Far in Advance Should I Book Event Technology for My Event?
event-technology-service.answer: As early as your date is confirmed. Demand peaks during wedding season, from April through October, when technicians and specialty stage lighting fixtures are the first things to fill up. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Which package is right for my event?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: It depends mainly on your guest count and event type: the Eco Pack for a party up to 50 guests, the Basic MICE Pack for a meeting up to 40 guests, the Product Presentation Pack for a presentation, dealership showcase or product launch regardless of headcount, the MICE Pack for a larger corporate event up to 120 guests, and the Wedding Pack for a wedding up to 80 guests. See The Package to Event Decision Table above for the full breakdown.

av-equipment-consultations.question: What information do you need to help me choose?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Your event date, your venue location, your expected guest count, and the type of equipment or package you are interested in, even if that is just a description of the event rather than a package name. See What Information We Need From You above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Is the consultation free?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Yes. Asking which package fits your event costs nothing on its own, every package price already covers delivery, setup and testing, and there is no separate fee anywhere in our pricing for the conversation that gets you there. See Is a Consultation Free above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Do I need a technician included, or can I run the equipment myself?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: That depends on how much attention you want free during your event, not a fixed rule. Our AV technician hire guide has the full package by package breakdown, and our AV system troubleshooting guide covers what to check yourself on the 3 packages with no technician on site.
