See Do You Need a Technician, or Can You Run It Yourself above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: My guest count falls between two packages, which should I pick?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Lean on event type, not the exact headcount. A party a few guests over the Eco Pack's 50 guest cap is rarely a problem. A corporate meeting a few guests over the Basic MICE Pack's 40 guest cap is a signal to step up to the MICE Pack rather than round down. See When Your Guest Count Falls Between Two Packages above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Why doesn't the Product Presentation Pack list a guest count?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Because it is chosen by what your event is, a corporate presentation, dealership showcase, or product launch, rather than by how many people attend. Its projector, screen and single wireless microphone work the same way whether 15 or 45 guests are watching. See Why the Product Presentation Pack Has No Guest Cap above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: What's the real difference between the Basic MICE Pack and the MICE Pack?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Beyond the guest cap, 40 against 120, the real difference is what is standard: the MICE Pack includes a technician for up to 6 continuous hours and a 60 inch LED display as standard, while the Basic MICE Pack offers a technician only as a 240 euro per day add on. See Basic MICE Pack vs MICE Pack above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Does my venue affect which package I should choose?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Rarely on its own. Guest count and event type decide the package first, venue mostly shapes what we plan around afterward, cable runs and weather exposure outdoors, or AV restrictions at a hotel ballroom. See Does Your Venue Change Which Package You Need above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: How far in advance should I book my consultation?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: As early as you can once your event date is set. Bookings need at least 24 hours' notice at minimum, and reaching out earlier gives us more room to confirm the right package and technician availability, especially during wedding season from April through October. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

av-equipment-consultations.question: Can I customize a package after I've already booked it?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Yes. Every package can be extended with priced add ons, projectors and screens, extra microphones, premium lecterns, staging, and additional technician hours. Our how to customize AV rental packages guide has the full priced list.

av-equipment-consultations.question: What if I'm not sure what I need at all?
av-equipment-consultations.answer: Describe your event rather than trying to guess a package name. Tell us your event date, guest count, venue and what kind of event it is, a party, a meeting, a presentation, or a wedding, and we will match it to one of our 5 packages for you. Contact us and start from the event, not the catalog.

stage-lighting-rental.question: What Stage Lighting Equipment Does MEG Actually Stock?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Five real products: 2 Eurolite LED KLS-200 light bars, 1 ADJ Encore FRI50Z Fresnel, 1 ADJ Element H6 Pack (6 wireless uplights), 2 RGBW LED light bars on the Eco Pack, and fairy lights on the Wedding Pack. See The Full Stage Lighting Roster above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Is Your Stage Lighting DMX Controlled or Programmable?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: No. The Eurolite bar runs on a foot pedal, the Fresnel is a fixed zoom wash light with no automated movement, and the uplighting kit's color is set by our technician on site, not through a DMX signal or an app. See Foot Pedal Control, Not DMX above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Do You Offer Moving Head or Intelligent Lighting Fixtures?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: No. We do not own DMX pan and tilt robotic fixtures. See What We Don't Stock above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Is Delivery, Setup and Collection Included, or Is Installation Billed Separately?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Included, for every fixture on this page. We do not have a separate "installation" business line: our crew delivers, positions, tests and collects the equipment as part of the rental. See Delivery, Setup, Testing and Collection above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: How Much Does Stage Lighting Rental Cost in Malaga?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: It depends on the fixture. The RGBW light bars are included at 290 euros ex VAT on the Eco Pack, and the fairy lights are included at 650 euros ex VAT on the Wedding Pack. The Eurolite bars, the Fresnel and the uplighting kit have no published a la carte price: contact us with your event details for a quote. See Stage Lighting by Package above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Which MEG Packages Bundle Both Sound and Lighting Together?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Only 2: the Eco Pack and the Wedding Pack. The Basic MICE Pack, Product Presentation Pack and MICE Pack all include sound, but their visual layer is a projection screen or LED display, not stage lighting. See Stage Lighting by Package above for the exact breakdown.

stage-lighting-rental.question: What Is the Difference Between Stage Lighting and Stage Uplighting?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Stage lighting, on this page, covers our full fixture roster: the Eurolite bars, the Fresnel, the RGBW spotlights and the uplighting kit together. Uplighting specifically is our ADJ Element H6 Pack, a wireless kit that washes a wall or structure with color from the floor, distinct from the Eurolite bar or Fresnel, which are fixed position wash and accent fixtures. We publish a deeper, dedicated guide on our uplighting kit alone, covering realistic venue coverage and outdoor use in more depth than this page does.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Can Stage Lighting Be Rented Without a Full Sound or Staging Package?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Yes, for the 3 fixtures that are not bundled into a package: the Eurolite bars, the Fresnel and the uplighting kit are all separate, quote on request items. The RGBW spotlights and fairy lights, however, are only available as part of the Eco Pack and Wedding Pack respectively, not as standalone rentals.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Is Stage Lighting Available for Outdoor Events?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Yes, with an honest caveat. We have not confirmed a weatherproof or IP rating for any of our 5 fixtures, the 3 specialty items or the RGBW bars and fairy lights bundled into a package, so we do not market any of them as rated outdoor equipment. In practice, our technician assesses conditions on site, places fixtures around whatever shelter the venue offers, and recommends a covered backup position if rain is a real risk on your date. See Outdoor Use: Power and Honest Weather Limits above for the fixture by fixture mounting and power breakdown.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Do You Provide Power for Outdoor Lighting Away From an Outlet?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Yes, for corded fixtures. We stock a 2000W portable electrical panel with a 380/220V transformer and a separate power stabilizer, which between them usually cover a corded fixture placed away from your venue's own outlet. The uplighting kit does not need this, it is wireless and battery powered. We do not stock a generator, so contact us with your venue's layout and we will confirm honestly whether your power situation works.

stage-lighting-rental.question: How Far in Advance Should I Book Stage Lighting for a Wedding or Corporate Event?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: As early as your date is confirmed. Demand peaks during wedding season, from April through October, and 2 of our 5 fixtures exist in very limited quantity, 2 Eurolite bars and 6 uplights total, so early booking matters more here than for higher volume equipment. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Does Stage Lighting Rental Include a Technician, or Do I Run It Myself?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: It depends on the fixture. The Eco Pack's RGBW light bars are set up and tested by our crew, then run without a technician for the rest of your event. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights come with a technician on site for the event. The Eurolite bars, Fresnel and uplighting kit are deployed with a technician who manages placement and, for the uplighting kit, color.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Is "Wireless Stage Lighting" the Same as Your Uplighting Kit?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Yes, all three search phrases point at the same real product in our catalog. We stock exactly one wireless lighting kit, the ADJ Element H6 Pack of 6 battery powered fixtures, so "wireless stage lighting," "stage uplighting" and "wireless uplighting" all resolve to that single item, not three different products.

stage-lighting-rental.question: Can Stage Lighting Be Combined With Staging Platforms for a Corporate Presentation?
stage-lighting-rental.answer: Yes. Our MICE Pack offers modular stage platforms as an optional add on at 35 euros per square meter, delivered, set up and collected the same way as our lighting fixtures. Contact us with your venue and we will confirm what combination fits your presentation.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: What should I ask before booking wedding AV rentals?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Ask what's included in the price, whether a technician is on site, how many guests the sound system covers, and whether the quoted price includes VAT. See the sections above for how Malaga Event Gear answers each one.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Does Malaga Event Gear provide a written breakdown of what's included?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Yes. The packages page itemizes exactly what's in the Wedding Pack: PA sound, lighting, microphones, transport, setup and the technician, at 650 euros ex VAT.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Is a technician always included in wedding AV packages?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Not necessarily, and it's worth asking directly. In our own catalog, only the Wedding Pack and the MICE Pack include a live technician on site throughout the event.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: What if a provider can't confirm availability for my date?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: Ask when they can confirm it, and keep that timeline in mind since availability, not price, is what limits a date. See our booking timeline guide.

questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.question: Does the price change based on guest count?
questions-to-ask-wedding-rental-companie.answer: The Wedding Pack is a flat 650 euros ex VAT for up to 80 guests. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options rather than assuming the same package scales automatically.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our Eco Pack covers PA sound, a microphone and lighting, with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and the price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: Is a technician included for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: No, not on the Eco Pack: it is a self run setup, delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then operated by the DJ or band themselves. A technician is included on our Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, though those are sized for a wedding or corporate event.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: What is the difference between a setup for a DJ and a live band?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: The base equipment is the same: PA sound, a microphone and lighting. A DJ typically brings their own mixer and controller and plugs into our sound system. A live band or duo uses the microphone for vocals and plugs their own instruments in directly.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How many microphones are included?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: The Eco Pack includes 1 wired dynamic microphone. If your performance needs more than one, let us know when you book.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: Can the sound system be used outdoors, at a villa or beach venue?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Yes. Our PA sound and lighting are set up regularly at villas, terraces and beach venues across the Costa del Sol. Confirm the venue's mains power when you book so we can size the setup correctly.

audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a music performance?
audio-visual-rental-for-music-performanc.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date and venue are confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros, and we recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: What is the difference between audio visual hire near me and audio video rental near me?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: They cover different parts of our catalog. Audio visual hire near me covers our general sound and lighting packages for weddings and parties. This page covers the screen and projector side of our catalog, for presentations, conferences and product launches.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: What size screen or projector do I need?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: For a smaller meeting room up to 40 guests, the Basic MICE Pack's 2x2m screen and 3000-lumen projector work well. For a larger conference room up to 120 guests, the MICE Pack's 60 inch LED display avoids a long projector throw distance. See Which Screen or Projector Fits Your Room above.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: Can I connect my own laptop to the projector or screen?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: Is a technician included?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Not on the Product Presentation Pack or Basic MICE Pack: the equipment is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. The MICE Pack includes a technician on site for up to six hours.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: How much does audio video rental cost near me?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger conference, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: Do you deliver audio video rental outside Malaga city?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Yes. Our delivery area covers the wider Costa del Sol, not just Malaga city: Marbella, Fuengirola, Torremolinos, Benalmadena, Estepona, Mijas, Nerja and Antequera are all in range, with Sevilla and Granada available for larger bookings. See Costa del Sol Coverage, Not Just Malaga City above.

audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.question: How far in advance should I book audio video rental?
audio-video-rental-near-me-in-malaga-spa.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

stage-uplighting.question: What Is Stage Uplighting and How Does It Work?
stage-uplighting.answer: Uplighting is a fixture placed on the floor or low against a wall, aimed upward to wash that surface, a column or a piece of structure with color, rather than spotlighting a fixed point. MEG's real version of this is one ADJ Element H6 Pack, a wireless, battery powered kit of 6 fixtures. See The Real Kit We Stock above for exactly what that kit is and is not.

stage-uplighting.question: How Many Uplights Do I Need for My Venue?
stage-uplighting.answer: With MEG, the honest answer is 6, our full inventory, not a guest count formula. That covers accent lighting for 2 to 4 specific venue features, an entrance, a head table or backdrop, a run of 2 to 3 columns, or one feature wall, rather than a full room wash. See Realistic Coverage above for how our technician decides which features to light.

stage-uplighting.question: Is Wireless Uplighting Better Than Wired?
stage-uplighting.answer: We do not offer a wired option to compare it against, so this is not a real choice you will make when booking with MEG. Our ADJ Element H6 Pack is wireless and battery powered, which is why it is the only uplighting kit in our inventory: it does not need a power run to each fixture, which is what makes it practical to place against a wall, column or backdrop wherever our technician needs it.

stage-uplighting.question: How Long Does the Battery Last?
stage-uplighting.answer: We have not confirmed a runtime figure for the ADJ Element H6 Pack, so we are not going to publish one here. What we can confirm is that the kit is battery powered and our technician manages it through your event, checking and repositioning fixtures as needed rather than leaving them unattended on a fixed runtime assumption.

stage-uplighting.question: Can Uplighting Be Used Outdoors?
stage-uplighting.answer: We have not confirmed a weatherproof or IP rating for this kit, so we do not market it as a rated outdoor fixture. In practice, our technician assesses conditions on site, places the kit around whatever shelter the venue offers, and recommends a covered backup position if rain is a real risk on your date. See Outdoor Events above.

stage-uplighting.question: What's the Difference Between Uplighting and the Eco Pack's RGBW Spotlights?
stage-uplighting.answer: Uplighting is floor mounted and wireless, washing a wall or structure with color from below wherever our technician positions it. The Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights are 2 light bars in a fixed position, set up and tested as part of that package, then self run for the rest of the event. See the full comparison table in Uplighting or the Eco Pack's RGBW Spotlights above.

stage-uplighting.question: Does Uplighting Come With Any of Your Packages?
stage-uplighting.answer: No. It is not included in the Eco Pack, Basic MICE Pack, Wedding Pack or MICE Pack. It is a separate, quote based item across all four, the same as our specialty stage lighting and our headset and lavalier microphones.

stage-uplighting.question: What Colors Can It Produce, and Can It Change Color During the Event?
stage-uplighting.answer: We have not confirmed a DMX or app based color control feature for this kit, so we do not offer it as a self controlled, color changing effect the way the Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights are. Our technician sets the color for your event on site, based on what you tell us when you book, rather than handing you a remote or an app to run it yourself.

stage-uplighting.question: What Can I Realistically Light With 6 Uplights?
stage-uplighting.answer: An entrance, a head table or ceremony backdrop, a run of 2 to 3 columns, or one feature wall behind a stage or dance floor, that is the realistic range for our 6 fixture kit. It is accent lighting for a handful of chosen features, not a wash for an entire reception room. Tell us which feature matters most to you and our technician will confirm coverage for your specific venue.

stage-uplighting.question: Is Wireless Stage Lighting the Same as Your Uplighting Kit?
stage-uplighting.answer: Yes. Whether you search "wireless stage lighting," "stage uplighting" or "wireless uplighting," the real product behind all three at MEG is the same: one ADJ Element H6 Pack of 6 wireless, battery powered fixtures.

stage-uplighting.question: Can Uplighting Be Added to a Corporate or MICE Event, Not Just a Wedding?
stage-uplighting.answer: Yes. Our event technology service pillar already lists this kit as lighting for a keynote stage or a gala dance floor, not just a private party. A feature wall behind a podium or the columns flanking a corporate stage are real uplighting placements for a MICE Pack or Basic MICE Pack booking. Contact us with your event details and we will confirm availability alongside your package.

indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.question: How does indoor wedding sound differ from outdoor?
indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.answer: Walls and hard surfaces reflect sound indoors, so an indoor PA is tuned to fill the room rather than project across open space the way an outdoor PA has to. Ceiling height and room shape also change how sound reflects, which is why our technician places speakers for the specific room rather than one fixed layout.

indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.question: Is a live technician necessary indoors, or can I self run the sound?
indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.answer: For a smaller indoor ceremony, up to 50 guests, the Eco Pack is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run without a technician. For a larger hall, or a room whose layout only becomes clear on the day, the Wedding Pack's live technician adjusts sound and lighting as the event unfolds.

indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.question: Does a room's acoustics affect microphone feedback?
indoor-wedding-rental-essentials.answer: Yes. A hall with hard floors and high ceilings reflects more sound back into open microphones than a carpeted room with soft furnishings, raising the risk of feedback if placement is not adjusted for the room. Our live technician manages that placement throughout the event as part of the Wedding Pack.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: What can I actually add to an AV rental package?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack adds a projector and screen or a smoke machine. The Basic MICE Pack adds a dedicated technician. The MICE Pack adds extra technician hours, a lectern or staging. See What You Can Actually Add above.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: Which packages can't be customized?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: The Wedding Pack and Product Presentation Pack ship as a fixed configuration, with no listed add-on menu. See Packages That Don't Flex above.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: Can I add a technician to a package that doesn't include one?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: Yes, on the Basic MICE Pack, a dedicated on-site technician is available for 240 euros per day. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack already include one.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: Can I add a lectern or staging to a corporate package?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: Yes, both are add-ons on the MICE Pack: a methacrylate lectern for 50 euros, and modular staging for 35 euros per square meter.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: Is a projector available as an add-on?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: Yes, on the Eco Pack, a projector and projection screen can be added for 50 euros.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: Are adapters for my own laptop included, or are they an extra cost?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: They are included at no extra cost on the Product Presentation Pack: HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces come with the package.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: How much does it cost to add extra technician hours?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: On the MICE Pack, an additional hour of on-site technical support beyond the included six costs 40 euros. All prices are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout.

how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.question: What if I need something that isn't on any package's add-on list?
how-to-customize-av-rental-packages.answer: Contact us directly. We do not add equipment or services outside a package's real inclusions and listed add-ons without confirming it first.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: What AV equipment do I need for an art exhibition opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Sound sized to your guest count and the room's acoustics, a microphone for opening remarks or an artist talk, and, if there is an artist statement or a video piece to show, a screen or laser projector. See What We Provide for an Exhibition Opening above.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Do I need a microphone for an artist talk or opening remarks?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Most openings benefit from one. Even a brief toast is easier heard over a standing crowd with a microphone than without, and a wireless handheld or gooseneck microphone lets a speaker move away from a fixed point, which matters more in a gallery than in a seated boardroom.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: How do you size sound for an exhibition opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: By your expected guest count and the room itself. Tile, polished concrete or plaster surfaces carry sound differently than a carpeted conference room, so tell us both when you book so our crew brings the right speaker pair for the space.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Can you project an artist statement or a video art piece with the gallery's lights on?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Yes. Our Product Presentation Pack's laser projector is rated at 5000 lumens specifically to stay legible in a lit room rather than a dark screening room, the same condition most gallery openings run under. See A Lit Room Legible Screen above.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Does Malaga Event Gear provide lighting for the artwork itself?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: No. We do not stock gallery track lighting, picture lights, or high CRI spotlighting built to illuminate artwork on a wall. See The Honest Line above for exactly what our lighting inventory is instead.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: What ambient lighting do you provide for the reception?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: RGBW LED light bars, included on the Eco Pack, and a wireless battery powered uplighting kit that washes a wall or column with color, available as an addition on larger packages. Both are reception atmosphere, not artwork illumination. See Ambient Lighting above.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for an art exhibition opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Eco Pack up to the MICE Pack for a larger gala style opening, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: What size opening does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: The Eco Pack covers up to 50 guests, the Basic MICE Pack up to 40, and the MICE Pack up to 120. The Product Presentation Pack is sized around a screen and speaker pair rather than a guest count. See Match Your Opening to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Is a technician included for an exhibition opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Only on the MICE Pack, included on site for up to 6 continuous hours. The Eco Pack, Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack are delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you or your team for the rest of the evening.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: How far in advance should I book AV for an exhibition opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. If your opening date is fixed against the exhibition's run, book as early as you can once your venue and guest count are confirmed.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Do you provide AV for the run of the exhibition, or just the opening?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: Just the opening or reception. We operate delivery only for a single event, not an ongoing systems install for an exhibition that stays up for weeks or months. See One Event, Not an Ongoing Installation above.

audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.question: Should an artist talk use a handheld or a gooseneck microphone?
audio-visual-rental-for-art-exhibitions.answer: A wireless handheld microphone suits a speaker who wants to move among the guests or the work itself, included on the Product Presentation Pack and the MICE Pack alongside a gooseneck. A gooseneck on a small podium suits a speaker who is comfortable staying in one place, included on the Basic MICE Pack and the MICE Pack.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: What is the most common mistake people make when renting AV equipment?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: Assuming a package includes something it doesn't, most often a technician or a projector. Check 10 Common Mistakes to Avoid above before you book.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: Does my AV rental package come with a technician?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: It depends on the package. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include one standard. The Basic MICE Pack offers one as a paid add on, at 240 euros per day.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: Do I need to test the equipment before the event starts?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: Our crew tests every setup on delivery, before your event starts. You never receive untested equipment.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: Do I need to arrange pickup or setup myself?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: No. Every package is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then collected again afterward. This is not a self-collect model.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: What size package do I actually need?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: It depends on your guest count: up to 40 for the Basic MICE Pack, 50 for the Eco Pack, 80 for the Wedding Pack, and 120 for the MICE Pack. If your list can still grow, book the next size up.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: How much does AV rental actually cost once VAT and extras are included?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: Every price on our packages page is ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. Add ons like a projector, extra technician hours, a lectern or staging are billed separately from the base price.

common-av-rental-mistakes.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment?
common-av-rental-mistakes.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

sound-system-rental.question: What is included in a sound system rental?
sound-system-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack includes 2 active speakers with stands, 1 wired dynamic microphone and 2 RGBW LED light bars, with no technician. The Basic MICE Pack includes a basic sound reinforcement system and 1 gooseneck microphone, with a technician available as a paid add on. The Wedding Pack includes a high end active PA sound system, wireless microphones and a technician. The MICE Pack includes a premium sound system, gooseneck and wireless handheld microphones, and a technician for up to 6 hours. See What's Included in a Sound System Rental above for the full breakdown.

sound-system-rental.question: Do I need a PA system for a DJ set, or something different for a speech heavy event?
sound-system-rental.answer: Both use a PA system, but the setup differs. A DJ set or party is served well by a self run PA system, like our Eco Pack, with a wired microphone for announcements and no technician. A speech heavy wedding, boardroom address or conference panel needs a wireless or gooseneck microphone paired with a technician managing levels live, which is what the Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack are built for.

sound-system-rental.question: Do you provide a technician with the sound system?
sound-system-rental.answer: Only on some packages. The Eco Pack is delivery, setup and teardown only, with no technician on site. The Basic MICE Pack offers a technician as a paid add on. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a live technician as standard, with the MICE Pack technician on site for up to 6 continuous hours. For the full breakdown of what that technician actually does on site, and how to book one specifically, see our AV technician hire guide.

sound-system-rental.question: Do you provide a generator or backup power for the sound system?
sound-system-rental.answer: No. None of our packages include a generator or backup power supply. If your venue, especially an outdoor villa or terrace, has uncertain mains power, confirm this with us when you request your quote so we can plan the setup around your venue's actual power supply.

sound-system-rental.question: How far in advance should I book a sound system rental?
sound-system-rental.answer: Book as early as you can once your event date is confirmed. Demand on the Costa del Sol peaks during wedding season, from April through October, when technicians and the most requested packages fill up first. See How Far in Advance to Book above.

sound-system-rental.question: Can you set up a sound system outdoors, or only indoors?
sound-system-rental.answer: Yes, both. Most of the sound systems we deliver go into villas, private terraces and hotel ballrooms across Malaga and the Costa del Sol, indoors and outdoors alike. Contact us with your venue details so we can confirm the right setup for it.

sound-system-rental.question: Is a PA system rental the same as a sound system rental?
sound-system-rental.answer: Yes, for our packages the two terms describe the same equipment. We use "PA system" and "sound system" interchangeably throughout this guide, and every package above is a PA system rental: a self run PA on the Eco Pack for a DJ set or party, or a technician managed PA on the Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack or MICE Pack for a speech heavy event. There is no separate PA system rental product or pricing tier.

sound-system-rental.question: Do you offer a portable, battery powered or self collect PA system?
sound-system-rental.answer: No. Every package we offer is delivered, installed, tested and collected by our own crew, never a self collect or self return unit, and none of our packages run on battery power. If a specific venue has uncertain mains power, contact us with the details and we will plan the setup around it rather than offer a battery powered substitute we don't stock.

sound-system-rental.question: Can I rent just speakers, without a microphone or technician?
sound-system-rental.answer: Not as an a la carte item. Our closest match for a speaker rental with no technician is the Eco Pack: 2 active speakers with stands, self run, no technician on site, but it's a fixed package that also includes 1 wired dynamic microphone and 2 LED light bars rather than speakers sold on their own. Contact us if your event genuinely needs speakers only, and we'll confirm what's possible.

sound-system-rental.question: What type of microphone do I need for my event?
sound-system-rental.answer: It depends on the package. The Eco Pack includes 1 wired dynamic microphone for announcements. The Basic MICE Pack includes 1 professional gooseneck microphone for a podium or lectern. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a wireless handheld microphone for speeches, with the MICE Pack adding a gooseneck microphone as well. We also stock wireless lavalier and headset microphones as a separate item from these package inclusions: contact us if your presenter or performer needs a hands free mic. See our headset and lavalier microphone rental guide for the full lavalier versus headset comparison and pricing.

sound-system-rental.question: Is a wireless microphone available, or only wired?
sound-system-rental.answer: Both, depending on the package. The Eco Pack uses a wired dynamic microphone. The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include a wireless handheld microphone instead, which is what most speeches and awards style presentations need.

sound-system-rental.question: Can I rent an audio mixer or mixing console on its own?
sound-system-rental.answer: No. Our digital mixing consoles are technician operated equipment built into the Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack, not a standalone rental item. On the Eco Pack, a DJ or band brings and runs their own mixer or controller, as covered in our audio visual rental for music performances guide.

sound-system-rental.question: Do you rent audio interfaces for recording or podcasting?
sound-system-rental.answer: No. We don't stock recording or podcasting style audio interfaces. For presentations, we provide HDMI and USB-C adapters to connect your laptop or tablet, and our packages include a digital mixing console for live sound, not studio recording gear.

wedding-rentals-near-me.question: What does "near me" mean if Malaga Event Gear has no showroom?
wedding-rentals-near-me.answer: It means proximity of delivery, not a location to visit. We operate delivery only, with no storefront, and bring the Wedding Pack directly to your venue for setup, live technical support and teardown.

wedding-rentals-near-me.question: What is included in the Wedding Pack?
wedding-rentals-near-me.answer: PA sound for up to 80 guests, fairy light and warm LED ambient lighting, wireless microphones, transport, professional setup and a live technician on site, for 650 euros ex VAT. See the full breakdown on our Wedding Pack page.

wedding-rentals-near-me.question: Do you serve areas outside Malaga city?
wedding-rentals-near-me.answer: Yes. Our service area covers Malaga and the wider Costa del Sol, and extends to Granada for rentals over 400 euros to cover the added travel distance.

wedding-rentals-near-me.question: How far in advance do I need to book?
wedding-rentals-near-me.answer: All bookings need at least 24 hours' notice. For a wedding date, contact us as soon as your venue is confirmed so we can hold the crew and equipment for your day.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: Who is responsible if a rented item is damaged at my wedding?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: Malaga Event Gear does not publish a damage deposit or liability policy for our AV equipment. Ask us directly at the quote stage if that matters to you. For furniture, tents or tableware, responsibility sits with whichever vendor supplied the item, not MEG.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: Do wedding rental companies charge a damage deposit?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: Many do, often a flat fee or a small percentage of the order. Practices vary by vendor and by item category. MEG does not publish a figure for AV equipment, so confirm directly with any vendor, including us.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: Is damage to rented AV equipment covered by wedding liability insurance?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: Not usually. A general event liability policy typically covers injury or property damage a couple causes to a venue, not damage to equipment a vendor owns. It is a fair question to raise with any vendor you book, MEG included.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: How is the sound and lighting protected outdoors?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: Through professional installation and a live technician who reads wind and ground conditions on site rather than a fixed layout. For the full outdoor picture, power, curfews and placement, see our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: Does the Wedding Pack cover furniture, tent or tableware protection?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: No. MEG supplies sound, lighting, microphones and a technician only. Furniture, tents, linens and tableware come from a different vendor. Our essential items for wedding rentals guide covers that full list.

protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.question: What are the most common damages with wedding rentals, and who pays for them?
protecting-your-wedding-rental-items.answer: For the furniture, tents, linens and tableware other vendors supply, a damage waiver or deposit is the usual answer, though the practice and figure vary by company. For the AV equipment MEG actually rents, we do not publish a damage figure or policy: professional installation and, on the Wedding Pack, a live technician who reacts to shifting weather or a bumped stand are the real protection, not a deposit clause. Ask any vendor, including us, for their specific terms at the quote stage rather than assume one applies.

making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.question: When should I send my run of show to the technician?
making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.answer: As soon as your ceremony time, speech order and any curfew are set, ideally well before your event. Services need at least 24 hours notice at minimum, so treat that as the latest possible point, not the target.

making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.question: How does the microphone get passed between multiple reception speakers?
making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.answer: The live technician manages it, adjusting gain as the mic changes hands for a louder or softer speaker and catching feedback before it starts. If your reception has five or more speakers, ask about adding a second wireless microphone when you book.

making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.question: Does the same technician cover both the ceremony and the reception?
making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Yes. The Wedding Pack's live technician stays on site throughout the event, covering the ceremony, the speeches and the dancing, rather than a fixed setup left to run itself.

making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.question: What if my venue has a sound curfew?
making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Tell us the curfew when you book and the technician plans volume and timing around it. See our outdoor wedding rental considerations guide for the fuller picture on curfews, wind and power.

making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.question: Can I add an extra microphone for a large wedding party?
making-the-most-of-wedding-rentals.answer: Yes. Every package can be extended with add ons, including extra microphones and additional technician hours. Tell us your requirements when requesting a quote.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: What AV equipment do I need for a corporate event?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: It depends on the event type. A product launch needs a sound system, a wireless microphone and a projector, which the Product Presentation Pack covers. A board meeting or small conference benefits from a gooseneck microphone and projector, which the Basic MICE Pack covers. A larger conference benefits from a bigger screen and a technician, which the MICE Pack covers.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a corporate event?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Product Presentation Pack up to the MICE Pack for a full conference, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: Do I need an on-site technician, or can I set up the equipment myself?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: It depends on the package. The Product Presentation Pack and Basic MICE Pack are delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. The MICE Pack includes a technician on site for up to six hours. See Dry Hire or Full Service? above.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: What size event does each package support?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: The Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests, and the MICE Pack covers up to 120. The Product Presentation Pack is sized for a presentation rather than a guest count. See Match Your Event to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: Is it better to rent locally or use a hotel's in-house AV provider?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: A local provider gives you transparent, itemized pricing and equipment you can see before you book, rather than a bundled hotel AV quote. We deliver, install and test the equipment ourselves at your chosen venue, whether that is a hotel, an office or another venue across Malaga and the Costa del Sol.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: What kind of microphones are included for a corporate presentation or panel?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: It depends on the package: a gooseneck microphone for a podium or panel on the Basic MICE Pack, or a gooseneck plus wireless handheld microphone on the MICE Pack for a speaker who moves between the podium and the audience.

audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a corporate event?
audio-visual-rental-for-corporate-events.answer: Book as early as you can once your date and venue are confirmed. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros, and we recommend booking at least 24 hours in advance.

tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.question: Can I negotiate the price of a wedding AV package?
tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.answer: No. MEG does not offer negotiated pricing, price matching against another vendor's quote, or a discount for a weekday or off season date. Package prices are fixed and quoted ex 21% VAT.

tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.question: Do I need a live technician for wedding sound, or can I run it myself?
tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.answer: The Eco Pack is self run after our crew delivers, installs and tests it, and suits up to 50 guests. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician throughout the event and suits up to 80 guests. Choosing Eco over Wedding when your guest count and comfort level allow it saves 360 euros.

tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.question: Does my venue already have a sound system I could use instead of renting?
tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.answer: Some fincas, hotels and villas around Malaga have a basic house PA. It can cover background music or a small ceremony, but it rarely includes a technician, wedding sized lighting, or wireless microphones for speeches, so confirm what your venue has before deciding what you still need to rent.

tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.question: Is there a minimum spend for weddings outside Malaga?
tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.answer: Within the Costa del Sol, no. For Granada and other out of province destinations, bookings need to exceed 400 euros to cover the single day logistical travel.

tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.question: Can I add or remove items from a wedding AV package to control cost?
tips-for-reducing-wedding-rental-costs.answer: You can add: a projector and screen, a smoke machine, extra microphones, a lectern, staging, or extra technician hours, all confirmed when you request a quote. There is no documented option to remove an included item from a package for a lower price.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: How Is This Different From Your General Wedding Lighting Guide?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: Our dedicated lighting ideas for wedding rentals guide covers the Wedding Pack's fairy lights and the Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights in full depth, placement by venue structure, pergolas, trees and walkways. This page organizes all 5 of our real stage lighting fixtures by wedding moment instead, including the ceremony uplighting and the band or speeches stage lighting that guide doesn't cover.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: Can You Light a Live Band or DJ Booth at a Wedding?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: Yes. The Eurolite LED KLS-200 bar and ADJ Encore FRI50Z Fresnel, both quote on request items, are aimed at whoever is performing or speaking, the same way they are used for a corporate stage. See A Band, DJ Booth or Speeches Stage above.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: How Many Uplights Do I Need for My Ceremony Backdrop?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: Our full inventory is 6 wireless fixtures, the ADJ Element H6 Pack, realistically covering 2 to 4 venue features, an arch, a head table, or a run of columns, not a full room wash. Our dedicated stage uplighting guide covers the honest coverage math and outdoor weather caveats in more depth.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: Is Stage Lighting Included in the Wedding Pack, or a Separate Quote?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: Only the fairy lights are included in the Wedding Pack. The ceremony uplighting kit and the band or speeches stage lighting are separate, quote on request items, the same as the Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights are included in that package specifically and nowhere else. See Wedding Pack, Eco Pack or a Separate Quote above.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: Do You Offer Moving Head or DMX Programmable Lighting for Weddings?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: No. The same as for any other event we light, our fixtures are foot pedal or fixed position, not DMX pan and tilt robotic rigs. See our stage lighting rental page for the full list of what we don't stock.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: Does a Finca, Villa Terrace, Marquee or Ballroom Change What You Recommend?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: Mostly in whether a fixture needs weather considered. We have not confirmed a weatherproof rating for the uplighting kit or our specialty fixtures, so for an open air finca or terrace wedding, our technician places them around whatever shelter the venue offers and confirms a covered backup position on site. An indoor ballroom or marquee removes that question entirely.

stage-lighting-for-weddings.question: Does Wedding Stage Lighting Include a Technician?
stage-lighting-for-weddings.answer: It depends on the fixture. The Wedding Pack's fairy lights come with a technician on site for the event. The Eco Pack's RGBW spotlights are set up and tested, then self run. The uplighting kit, the Eurolite bar and the Fresnel are all deployed with a technician who manages placement, and for the uplighting kit, color, for your event.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: What AV equipment do I need for a seminar?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A laser projector and screen for slides, PA sound, and a microphone for the presenter. The Product Presentation Pack and Basic MICE Pack cover these needs at different scales. See Match Your Seminar to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a seminar?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Pricing depends on the package: our full catalog, from the Basic MICE Pack up to the Product Presentation Pack, is listed with exact euro pricing on our packages page. All rates are ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout, and every price includes delivery, setup and teardown.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: What is the difference between AV for a small seminar and a larger one?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A single presenter with a wireless mic fits the Product Presentation Pack. A lectern-style seminar or workshop up to 40 guests fits the Basic MICE Pack, which uses a gooseneck podium microphone instead.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: What microphone is best for a seminar speaker?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: A wireless handheld microphone, included on the Product Presentation Pack, suits a presenter who moves around. A gooseneck microphone, included on the Basic MICE Pack, suits a lectern or podium format.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: Do I need a technician for a seminar AV setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Not on the Product Presentation Pack: the equipment is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. On the Basic MICE Pack, a technician is available as an add on.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: Can I connect my own laptop to the projector?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How many people can attend a seminar with a standard AV setup?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: The Basic MICE Pack covers up to 40 guests. For a larger seminar, see our audio visual rental for conferences guide.

audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.question: How far in advance should I book AV equipment for a seminar?
audio-visual-rental-for-seminars.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: What AV equipment do I need for a training session?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: It depends on your group size and format. A small, laptop-driven workshop needs a sound system, a wireless microphone and a projector, which the Product Presentation Pack covers. A larger session benefits from a bigger screen and a technician, which the Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack cover. See Match Your Training Session to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Is my training session too small for professional AV support?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: No. Our Product Presentation Pack is built for a small, laptop-driven session, with sound, a wireless microphone and a projector delivered, installed and tested by our crew.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Do you provide on-site technical support during the session, or is it drop-off equipment only?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: It depends on the package. The Product Presentation Pack is delivered, installed and tested by our crew, then run by you. The Basic MICE Pack offers a technician as an add on, and the MICE Pack includes one on site for up to six hours.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Can the AV setup handle a trainer moving between breakout groups?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Yes. Our wireless handheld microphones, included on the Product Presentation Pack and MICE Pack, let a trainer move freely between groups and exercise stations without losing sound clarity. See Trainer Mobility above.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: Can I connect my own laptop for my training slides?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Yes. The Product Presentation Pack includes HDMI and USB-C adapters plus audio interfaces to connect your own laptop, tablet or media player.

audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.question: What areas do you cover, and how far in advance should I book?
audio-visual-rental-for-training-session.answer: Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros. Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability.

av-cable-management.question: What does "aesthetic cabling" actually mean when I book a package?
av-cable-management.answer: Careful, consistent cable routing along walls, furniture lines, or floor edges, with anything crossing a walking path taped flat and secured, done by the same crew that installs your equipment. See What Aesthetic Cabling Actually Means above.

av-cable-management.question: Is cable management included in the price, or an extra charge?
av-cable-management.answer: Included as standard on the Eco Pack, Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack, and MICE Pack, each of which names it directly in its includes list. The Product Presentation Pack's includes list does not name a separate cabling line, though basic routing is still part of every booking's professional setup. A genuinely difficult site or an unusually long cable run can trigger a real, separately valued installation complement, honestly disclosed here rather than left for the day of your event. See Is Cable Management Included in Every Package and When a Difficult Site Adds an Installation Complement above.

av-cable-management.question: Do cables create a trip hazard at my event?
av-cable-management.answer: That is exactly what the routing is meant to prevent: cables kept out of primary walking paths where possible, and taped flat wherever they do cross one. It is one of the 2 real reasons behind the "aesthetic cabling" line in our packages, alongside how the setup looks in photos. See What Aesthetic Cabling Actually Means above.

av-cable-management.question: How do you route cables at an outdoor venue like a villa or beach club?
av-cable-management.answer: The same routing and securing habits, adapted to whatever ground surface the venue has, grass, sand, or terrace paving. Our audio visual rental for outdoor events guide covers ground surface and power planning outdoors in full. See Cable Management Outdoors above.

av-cable-management.question: What's the longest cable run MEG can set up?
av-cable-management.answer: It depends on the cable type. Our inventory stocks VGA up to 42 meters, video up to 30 meters, speaker cable up to 25 meters, and microphone and power extension cable up to 20 meters each. See How Far Can We Run a Cable above for the full breakdown.

av-cable-management.question: Will cables be visible in my wedding or event photos?
av-cable-management.answer: We route cable specifically to minimize this, along walls and floor edges rather than through open sightlines, but we do not claim cables are ever fully invisible, only kept out of the way as far as the venue layout allows. See What Aesthetic Cabling Actually Means above.

av-cable-management.question: Do you bury cables or use cable ramps for high traffic areas?
av-cable-management.answer: No, honestly. We do not trench or bury cable runs, that is permanent installation work outside our delivery only model, and we do not stock a named cable ramp or raceway product. We route and tape cable flat along walls and floor edges instead. See What We Do Not Do above.

av-cable-management.question: Does weather affect how cables are managed outdoors?
av-cable-management.answer: Yes, in the same way it affects the rest of an outdoor setup. Our weather considerations for outdoor rentals guide covers how we plan around it in full rather than repeating it here.

av-cable-management.question: What happens if a cable gets in the way or comes loose during my event?
av-cable-management.answer: On a self run package with no technician on site, a cable knocked loose while moving a table or a stand is one of the most common causes of a sudden sound or connection issue. Our AV system troubleshooting guide covers what to check yourself if that happens mid event.

av-cable-management.question: Is cable management different for a small party versus a large corporate event?
av-cable-management.answer: The habits are the same, but the scale changes what there is to route. The Eco Pack has 2 speakers and 2 light bars to manage cable around. The MICE Pack's catalog description calls out "custom wiring setup" specifically because a 60 inch display, dual microphones, and a longer event with an on-site technician managing the run throughout is a genuinely more complex job than a small party's setup. See Is Cable Management Included in Every Package above.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: What's included in an all in one wedding rental package from Malaga Event Gear?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: The Wedding Pack includes a high end PA sound system for up to 80 guests, warm ambient lighting, wireless microphones for vows and speeches, transport, professional setup, a live technician on site throughout the event, and post event teardown, all for 650 euros ex VAT.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Does the all in one package include venue, catering or furniture?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: No. The Wedding Pack covers audio visual equipment only: sound, lighting, microphones and a technician. Venue, catering, furniture, decor and photography are separate trades and are not part of this package.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Is booking one all in one package cheaper than hiring separate AV vendors?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: It removes the coordination cost of managing separate suppliers, separate delivery windows and separate contacts on the day, even where the equipment itself is comparable. One quote and one team on site is the main practical benefit.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: Is a technician included in the package?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: Yes. The Wedding Pack includes a live technician on site throughout the event, one of only two packages in our catalog that does, alongside the MICE Pack.

all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.question: How many guests does the package support?
all-in-one-wedding-rental-packages.answer: Up to 80 guests, sized for a villa, finca or wedding hotel. For a larger wedding, contact us to discuss options.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: What is included in audio visual rental for a private party?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: The Eco Pack includes 2 high quality active speakers with stands, 1 wired dynamic microphone, 2 RGBW LED light bars, and aesthetic cabling with professional setup, for 290 euros ex VAT, up to 50 guests.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: Is a technician included for a private party?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: No, not by default. Our crew delivers, installs and tests the Eco Pack on site, then it runs self run for the rest of the event, without a technician standing by. A technician is included on our Wedding Pack and MICE Pack, though those are sized and priced for a wedding or corporate event rather than a private party.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: How many guests can the Eco Pack support?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: Up to 50 guests. That is the real ceiling on this package, matched to a villa garden, a private room or a terrace, not a larger celebration.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: What extras are available for a private party?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: A projector and projection screen (+50 euros), useful for a photo slideshow or video montage, and a professional smoke/fog machine (+20 euros), for a dance floor moment or a cake reveal. Both are optional add ons, not part of the base package.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: How much does audio visual rental cost for a private party?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: The Eco Pack costs 290 euros, ex VAT, with 21 percent Spanish VAT added at checkout. The price includes delivery, setup and teardown. See exact pricing and the two optional add ons on our packages page.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: How far in advance should I book AV for a private party?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability. Our services are available in Malaga and extend to Granada for rentals over 400 euros.

audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.question: How long has Malaga Event Gear been providing audio visual rental?
audio-visual-rental-for-private-parties.answer: Backed by experience going back to 1996, three decades of live events across Malaga and the Costa del Sol.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Do you provide LED video walls for a trade show booth?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: No. Our large format display is a single premium 60 inch high definition LED screen with a designer stand, not a modular tiled LED video wall. See The Honest Line above.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Do you design or build exhibition booths and stands?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: No. We do not offer booth design, fabrication or construction. We supply the AV, screen, sound, microphone and lighting, for a stand you or a booth builder have already set up.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Can you rig or suspend a screen or signage above our stand?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: No. We carry zero rigging or truss stock, confirmed against our own inventory, and every screen, speaker, microphone and light we deliver is floor or stand mounted. See our audio visual rental safety guidelines for the full honest picture on this.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Do you rent touchscreens, kiosks or laptops for a registration desk?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: No. These are not real bookable products in our catalog, and we do not publish a spec sheet or a quote for equipment we do not stock.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: What is your day rate for a multi day trade show?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: We do not publish one. We operate delivery only, priced per single event, not per day. Multi day work is possible, as it was for the four day PROGOLD SUMMIT 2026 in Torremolinos, but it is quoted individually rather than sold off a standard rate card. Contact us for a custom quote. See The Honest Line above.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: What AV equipment do I actually get for my stand?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: A screen or projector for a product demo, sound sized to your stand's own footprint, a wireless handheld microphone for a presenter, and, on the Eco Pack, ambient RGBW lighting. See What We Provide for Your Own Stand above.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Will your sound system compete with the noise of a busy exhibition hall?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: No, and it is not built to. Our speaker pairs are sized to your stand's own footprint, not to outproject a neighboring stand or fill a whole hall. See Sound Sized to Your Stand, Not the Whole Hall above.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Which package fits a product demo at our stand?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: Most often the Product Presentation Pack, which bundles the lit room legible laser projector with a wireless handheld microphone and sound. A larger, staffed stand fits the Basic MICE Pack or MICE Pack instead. See Match Your Stand to a Package above.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: Is a technician available for the full show day, or just part of it?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: The MICE Pack includes a technician for up to 6 continuous hours. For a full show day, the Basic MICE Pack's optional dedicated on site technician add on, at 240 euros per day, is the closer fit. The Eco Pack and Product Presentation Pack are self run after our crew installs and tests the system.

audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.question: How far in advance should we book for a trade show?
audio-visual-rental-for-trade-shows.answer: Book at least 24 hours in advance to guarantee availability, and earlier once your show dates and stand size are confirmed, particularly if the show runs multiple days or needs a custom quote. See our audio visual rental planning timeline guide for the full process.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: What packages include a technician who handles troubleshooting for me, and which don't?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: The Wedding Pack and MICE Pack include one as standard. The Basic MICE Pack offers one as a paid add on at 240 euros per day. The Eco Pack and Product Presentation Pack do not offer one at all, at any price. See Running Your Own Equipment above.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: If I'm running my own equipment, what should I check myself if something stops working?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: It depends on which package you have, since the three self run packages carry different equipment. Cable seating applies to all three. A mixing console and wireless microphone only exist on the Product Presentation Pack. A projector applies to the Product Presentation Pack and the Basic MICE Pack, not the Eco Pack unless you added it as an option. See Self Check by Package above for the full breakdown.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Why did my wireless microphone cut out, and what can I do about it during the event?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: This applies specifically to the Product Presentation Pack, the only one of the three self run packages with a wireless microphone. Check the battery level first, then confirm it is set to the same channel as its receiver, most drops come from one of those two things rather than the unit itself. The Eco Pack has a wired dynamic microphone and the Basic MICE Pack's gooseneck microphone is wired to the podium, so neither one has this issue.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: My projector isn't syncing to the screen, what do I check first?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: Check that the input source selected on the projector, usually HDMI or the port in use, matches the laptop or device actually connected right now. This applies to the Product Presentation Pack and the Basic MICE Pack, both of which include a projector and screen as standard. See Self Check by Package above.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Why is there feedback or a buzzing sound from the speakers?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: Feedback, a rising squeal, usually means a microphone has moved too close to a speaker or is pointed toward one, moving it or angling it away is the first thing to try. A steady buzz more often points to a cable crossing a power line or a loose connection, so retracing the cable run and reseating both ends is worth doing before assuming a fault. See Feedback or Buzzing From the Speakers above.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Who do I call if equipment stops working during my event?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: Check cables, gain, battery and input selection first. If that does not fix it, we are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for technical setups and live event monitoring, including on self run packages. Contact us or call 600 42 87 50.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Does Malaga Event Gear only rent equipment and walk away, or is help available if something goes wrong later?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: We deliver, install and test every booking before we leave, so it works correctly at handover, but we do not disappear after that. Our line is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for technical setups and live event monitoring, even on the Eco Pack, Product Presentation Pack and Basic MICE Pack without the technician add on. See Before You Troubleshoot above.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Can I add a technician mid booking if I decide I don't want to troubleshoot my own equipment?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: On the Basic MICE Pack, yes, the technician is a paid add on at 240 euros per day, so tell us as soon as you decide rather than waiting until the day of your event, since it needs to be scheduled the same as the equipment itself. The Eco Pack and Product Presentation Pack do not offer a technician at any price. See Want a Technician Instead of Troubleshooting It Yourself above.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: Is troubleshooting different for outdoor events?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: The checks are the same, cables, gain, battery, input selection, but wind and cable exposure outdoors add more ways for a connection to get knocked loose in the first place. See our audio visual rental for outdoor events guide for how we plan for that before your event starts.

av-system-troubleshooting.question: What is the difference between a technician fixing an issue and me fixing it myself?
av-system-troubleshooting.answer: A technician is watching the levels continuously, so a dropped connection or a muted channel gets caught the moment it happens. Running your own equipment means you only notice once it is already affecting your event, and the fix is whichever quick check on this page matches your package. Neither is wrong, it is a question of whether your package includes that continuous watch or not. See Running Your Own Equipment above for which packages include one.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Is the Difference Between This Page and Your General Audio Visual Rental Page?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: They describe the same core service. Our audio visual rental page covers the full package range, from the Eco Pack up to the MICE Pack. This page indexes the specialized and niche equipment layer inside that same catalog, the laser projector tier, RGBW spotlights, specialty stage lighting and uplighting, wireless and gooseneck microphones, the 60 inch LED display and special effects, plus an honest list of what falls outside our catalog. See Why This Page Exists above.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent a Mixing Console or Audio Mixer on Its Own?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. Our digital mixing consoles are technician operated equipment built into the Wedding Pack, Basic MICE Pack and MICE Pack, not a standalone rental item. See our sound system rental guide for the full detail.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Offer Headset or Lavalier Microphones?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Yes. We stock wireless lavalier and headset microphones as a separate item from our package inclusions, for a presenter or performer who needs a hands free mic. See Wireless and Gooseneck Microphone Systems above, and our headset and lavalier microphone rental guide for the full comparison and pricing.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Provide Simultaneous Interpretation or Translation Equipment?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Not from our own equipment catalog, but yes as an arranged service: we don't stock interpretation hardware ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner to cover it rather than turn the request away. Contact us with your language pairs and guest count.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Is Uplighting and Do You Rent It?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Uplighting sits on the floor and washes light upward against a wall or structure. Yes, we rent it: a wireless, battery powered uplighting kit of 6 fixtures, a separate item from the Eco Pack's RGBW light bars, which spotlight and color a room from a fixed position rather than washing a wall from the floor. Contact us with your venue and guest count for a quote. See our stage uplighting guide for honest venue coverage, or our lighting ideas for wedding rentals guide for the full wedding picture.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent a Video Wall or LED Wall?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. Our large format display is a single 60 inch flat panel screen on a designer stand, not a modular tiled video wall built from stacked LED cabinets. See our TV screen rental guide for what we publish instead.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Can I Rent a Projection Screen Without a Projector, or Vice Versa?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: No. We do not sell a projection screen on its own, and we do not rent a projector without one. Every screen we deploy is bundled with a projector sized to it, whether that's the Eco Pack's 50 euro add on or the fixed screen and projector inclusion on the Basic MICE Pack and Product Presentation Pack. See our projector rental guide for the full breakdown.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Provide Interactive Voting or Audience Response Systems?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Not from our own equipment catalog, but yes as an arranged service: clicker devices, live polling hardware and interactive voting systems aren't something we stock ourselves, so we bring in a subcontracted partner to cover them for a congress or corporate event. Contact us with your requirements.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: What Laser or Special Lighting Effects Do You Offer?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Our brightest projector is a 5000 lumen Full HD laser unit on the Product Presentation Pack. On the effects side, our catalog lists low lying fog machines for a cloud effect, hazers to enhance light beams, and professional confetti cannons, with the fog machine published as a 20 euro Eco Pack add on. We do not offer laser light shows, gobo or monogram projection, or hologram displays. See Special Effects above.

audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.question: Do You Rent Staging, Truss or Pipe and Drape?
audiovisual-equipment-rental-service.answer: Staging, yes, as a priced add on: modular stage platforms at 35 euros per square meter on the MICE Pack. Truss, no, we don't stock it as a separate rental item. Pipe and drape or event backdrops, also no: we are not a decor provider, and that's stated directly on our unique wedding ceremony rentals guide. See Modular Staging for Corporate Events above.

technical-support-for-events.question: What happens during my event? A quick coverage checklist
technical-support-for-events.answer: Calibration and testing before your guests arrive, live gain and signal monitoring while your event runs, on the spot troubleshooting if a microphone or projector fails, and teardown once your event ends. See What Actually Happens During Your Event above for the full phase by phase breakdown.

technical-support-for-events.question: Is technical support for events the same as AV technician hire?
technical-support-for-events.answer: They cover the same crew from two different angles. Our AV technician hire guide covers hiring the person: which package includes one, which charges extra, and how many hours. This page covers what that person actually does on site once your event starts.

technical-support-for-events.question: What happens if a microphone drops or a projector loses sync mid presentation?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Our technician fixes it in the moment, using the specific equipment we carry: a channel switch or battery change for an Audix wireless microphone, or a resync against the correct Vivitek or Christie projector and screen pairing. See Real Equipment, Real Troubleshooting above.

technical-support-for-events.question: Do you provide technical support for multi day events?
technical-support-for-events.answer: Yes. On a two day corporate project for Bmotion in Benahavis, our technicians monitored sound and video continuously from a control panel across both days rather than recalibrating from zero each morning. See Coverage Across a Multi Day Event above.

technical-support-for-events.question: How many crew members are on site, and how fast do they respond?
